author: Samsung
description:
Jonathan Adler brings his signature Modern American Glamour to Samsung Art TVs with an exclusive 24-piece collection on the Samsung Art Store. Twelve works from Adler's archive, plus playful takes on each zodiac sign. Display your own sign year-round, mark a loved one's birthday month, or change the art with the season.
